title: St. Vincent–St. Mary vs. St. Edward — Boys Basketball (2025–2026)
summary: After trailing by four at halftime, the Eagles outscore the Irish 26–11 in a decisive third period.
short_label: ST. V VS. ST. EDWARD / BOYS BASKETBALL
article_headline: St. Edward Uses Big Third Quarter to Beat STVM 70–57
article_dek: After trailing by four at halftime, the Eagles outscore the Irish 26–11 in a decisive third period.
article_body:
LAKEWOOD, Ohio — St. Edward defeated St. Vincent–St. Mary 70–57 on January 30, 2026, after flipping a halftime deficit with a decisive third quarter. The Irish led 28–24 at the break, but the Eagles changed the game after halftime.

The teams finished the first period tied at 16. The Irish edged the second quarter 12–8, but St. Edward came out of the locker room with a 26–11 advantage in the third. That surge turned a four-point deficit into an 11-point lead entering the fourth.

The Eagles added 20 points in the final period to finish the 13-point victory. Senior JT Kelsheimer scored 16 points for St. Edward, according to the published box score.

Mason Bybee’s courtside photographs document the Irish–Eagles matchup and the players at the center of the action.
article_highlights: St. Vincent–St. Mary led 28–24 at halftime after a 16–16 first quarter.
St. Edward outscored the Irish 26–11 in the third, reversing the four-point halftime deficit and taking a 50–39 lead.
The Eagles completed the 70–57 win with a 20-point fourth quarter; JT Kelsheimer contributed 16 points for St. Edward.
